result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal carousel, a missing Orders tab icon in the bottom navigation, and a partially cut-off promo banner on the right.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow card titles to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure horizontal cards allocate enough width so names are not clipped mid-word.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which all show icons.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt or bag) above the Orders label for visual consistency and clearer navigation.

issues.description: The green promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you') appears slightly clipped or uneven on the right edge with the decorative circles.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the banner has consistent padding and that background graphics fully fit within the rounded container bounds.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends with a partially visible chip on the far right, which can look unfinished (though horizontal scroll may be intended).
issues.suggestion: If not intentional scroll affordance, add fade/peek styling or ensure chips fit; otherwise this can be left as-is per design.
